psp_version_note: Local pinned PhosphoSitePlus marker. Upstream had already rolled to 071726 during E4 and the paper used 2020-09-08, so any comparison against the frozen Phos freq must first read the installed marker: match -> exact compare, mismatch -> SKIP (Ruling 2).
seq_source_note: IDR must use the archive-era sequence: spec 2.7 measured 91 of 101 IDR mismatches came from uniprot-cache sequences.

archive.structure: flat dict accession -> record with capitalised top-level tool keys (catGRANULE, PLAAC, ...) and a PhaSePred dict; NOT the web API's data.tools.* envelope that spec 2.8 described.

predictions.files: predict_<mode>_<ACC>.csv (header + one row, exact predict output)
predictions.note: Local frozen four-mode scores (spec 4.5/G8), compared exactly. The hSaPS/hPdPS Phos freq column is marker-gated (Ruling 2).

environment_fingerprint.phos_freq_gold: local frozen Phos freq column of predict_<mode>_<ACC>.csv; marker-gated (Ruling 2 -- spec 2.7 forbids the web value)

environment_fingerprint_note: Ruling 8: python/xgboost/pandas/numpy/sklearn versions, the four 8f_model_0.joblib sha256 values (spec 2.2) and the frozen generation date are recorded as FACTS. They are NOT a compatibility gate: a purpose-built xgboost 3.4.1 regeneration produced byte-identical CSVs, so downstream comparisons must not skip or fail on the xgboost minor. The hSaPS/hPdPS Phos freq column is marker-gated (Ruling 2).
